text: moqi-tui 是 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式终端客户端，通过 DSH profile 启动并管理 Harness 会话。界面支持标签或平铺显示多个会话、恢复上次打开的会话，并可将当前对话导出为 Markdown。项目或全局记忆可由 agent 保存、读取和删除，供后续请求使用；用户也可调整模型、主题、权限模式及工作区隔离方式。适合希望在命令行中使用 Harness 并延续项目背景的开发者。需要 Node.js 22 以上、DSH CLI 和 pnpm；查询 DeepSeek 余额时可使用 DSH 凭据中的 API key。

moqi-tui is a terminal client for DeepSeek Harness. It manages multiple sessions, restores them, and exports conversations as Markdown. Agents can save and reuse project or global memories. Requires Node.js 22+, DSH CLI, and pnpm; a stored DSH credential supports DeepSeek balance lookup.

moqi-tui 的功能「跨会话记忆」：agent 可用 memory_save、memory_read 和 memory_forget 工具维护项目或全局记忆；记忆索引会随请求提供给 agent。
moqi-tui 的功能「会话并行与恢复」：在终端中以标签或平铺方式查看多个会话，可恢复上次打开的会话，并通过 /sessions 浏览会话。
moqi-tui 的功能「导出对话」：使用会话导出操作，将当前会话的用户消息、助手文本和工具调用顺序写入 Markdown 文件。
moqi-tui 查询 DeepSeek 余额时会使用 DSH 中保存的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 请求 api.deepseek.com；未配置该凭据时余额不可用。

moqi-tui README · Moqi：A terminal app for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness),
packaged as a `dsh` profile. A good terminal agent is one you stop having to
explain yourself to: Moqi keeps the conversation in the order it happened,
puts each tool call where it was made, and gets out of the way.

moqi-tui README · Highlights：- **Tool calls, where they happened** — each call renders inline between the
  prose on either side of it, collapsed to one row with its own spinner and
  status; `ctrl+o` opens the outcome underneath
  ([docs/using-moqi.md](docs/using-moqi.md#tool-calls-where-they-happened)).
- **Approvals that remember** — allow a command once, for this session, or
  always (per project or everywhere); a rule like `bash(git log *)` then
  answers matching calls without asking, and `/permissions` reviews them
  ([docs/using-moqi.md](docs/using-moqi.md#approvals-and-permission-rules)).
- **Memory across sessions** — the agent saves facts with `memory_save`, every
  session sees the list, `/memory` opens it in `$EDITOR`, `# note` keeps a
  line without sending it, and `/memory off` switches it all off
  ([docs/using-moqi.md](docs/using-moqi.md#memory)).
- **A branch of its own** — a new session in a git repo works on a `moqi/`
  branch in place, or in a worktree with `/worktree`; untouched ones are
  tidied up, and the agent is told the rules
  ([docs/using-moqi.md](docs/using-moqi.md#branches-and-worktrees)).
- **`shift+tab` modes** — read-only, workspace-write, or plan

moqi-tui README · Install：Needs Node 22+, the dsh CLI and pnpm. The same line works on Linux, macOS and
Windows:

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm moqi-tui
moqi
```

The launcher installs the profile and hands the terminal to dsh. pnpm is
required because the profile is a pnpm project. Without it, `moqi install`
stops and tells you to install it.

The dsh **desktop app** gives you no `dsh` command. Moqi needs the CLI, so run
the line above even if the desktop app is installed.
